feature_descriptions.log_rv_d: log of 21 x (last day's return squared)
feature_descriptions.log_rv_w: log of 21-day variance from the last 5 trading days (needs 3 with a return)
feature_descriptions.log_rv_m: log of 21-day variance from the last 22 trading days (needs 15)
feature_descriptions.log_rv_q: log of 21-day variance from the last 63 trading days (needs 40)
feature_descriptions.log_rv_y: log of 21-day variance from the last 252 trading days (needs 150)
feature_descriptions.ret_m: compounded return over the last 22 trading days
feature_descriptions.ret_q: compounded return over the last 63 trading days (needs 40)
feature_descriptions.log_mcap: log of month-end market value (abs price x shares outstanding, thousands of dollars)
feature_descriptions.log_turnover_m: log of (mean daily volume / shares outstanding + 1e-6) over the last 22 trading days (needs 15)
feature_descriptions.log_amihud_m: log of mean daily |return| per million dollars traded over the last 22 trading days (needs 10)
feature_descriptions.frac_valid_m: share of the last 22 trading days with a return
feature_descriptions.mkt_log_rv_m: log of 21-day variance of the equal-weighted universe daily return over the last 22 trading days
